title: 雲海最果ての灯火と、迷子の演算機
author: 鳴神 迅

en.title: The Beacon at the End of the Sea of Clouds and the Stray Calculator
en.premise: A fallen genius mechanic picks up an amnesiac AI from a junk shop's scrap heap—one that simply wishes to be guided. What the AI holds are the coordinates to the legendary 'Finest Lighthouse,' said to purify the world. Fleeing from imperial pursuers, a high-speed flight and adventure soaring through the skies begins.

zh.title: 云海尽头的灯火与迷路运算机
zh.premise: 一名落魄的天才青年机械师，在废品店的垃圾堆里捡到了一台祈求“希望你能引导我”的失忆AI。AI所保留的，是据传能净化世界的传说中“尽头灯塔”的坐标。逃离帝国的追兵，一场驰骋天际的高速逃亡与冒险就此拉开帷幕。
